subject: Onsite demo crates, swag bundles, and return logistics for May 18 exec session

Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: May 18 onsite workshop — shipping details

Diego,

Thanks again for agreeing to bring a couple of demo units and swag for our executive workshop on May 18. Can you confirm:

- What exactly you will ship (models, quantities)
- When it will arrive to 3rd floor conference (venue address in attached PDF)
- Whether Redwood will handle on-site setup and teardown or the venue will do staging
- Any insurance/value declaration we need to provide to our facilities team

Onsite lead: Evan Brooks (cc'd) will handle building access and will need a 2-hour arrival window. We also need printed one-pagers (5 copies each of the product brief) included with the collateral.

Appreciate a packing list and return procedure so procurement can sign off.

Best,
Laura

Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Corporation
laura.jensen@acme.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: May 18 onsite workshop — shipping details

Laura — thanks, and great to be partnering on this. Quick answers and plan below.

- What we'll ship: two hardened demo crates (contain 2x Redwood inference demo rigs: Model R-XL and Model R-Lite, serials RXL-2102 / RL-0983), one collateral box with printed one-pagers (5x each of 6 briefs = 30 total), two swag bundles (100 branded notebooks, 100 tech stickers, 50 tees) and one soft case with spare power bricks, console laptop, and HDMI adapters.
- Estimated weight/size: each crate ~160 lb (80"x40"x40" pallet-friendly), collateral box ~35 lb.
- Arrival: we'll schedule carrier delivery for May 17 between 10:00–14:00 to the service entrance; Evan, please confirm loading-dock access or whether we should plan for hand-carry to 3rd floor.
- Onsite setup/teardown: Redwood will provide on-site setup (Diego + Marissa will verify device boot, network test, and a dry-run for demos). Teardown: Redwood will handle packing and hand back to carrier for return the following business day (May 19).
- Insurance: declared value per crate is $9,500; collateral box $1,200. Please confirm Acme is comfortable with those values for building manifest.

Attached: preliminary packing list and swag inventory. Marissa, can you manage booking the freight and return labels? Grace, can you confirm we have printed one-pagers in the Drive link?

Thanks — will follow up with carrier ETA and tracking as soon as confirmed.

Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

Attachments: demo-kit-packing-list.pdf, swag-inventory-202605.xlsx

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme onsite shipping — vendor & return plan

Team — copying the plan I'm confirming with Acme. Action items below.

Shipment details (to pass to carrier):
- Pickup: Redwood HQ fulfillment (San Mateo) on May 16 by 1500; delivery to Acme HQ service entrance on May 17 between 1000–1400.
- Pieces: 2 crates (R-XL / R-Lite), 1 collateral box, 2 swag boxes, 1 electronics soft case.
- Pallet requirement: two skid pallets; liftgate required at both ends.
- Declared values: crate A $9,500; crate B $9,500; collateral $1,200; swag $850.
- Special: crate locking pins will be removed by us on-site; annotate "Fragile — electronic equipment" on airway bill.

RETURN plan:
- Pre-purchase return labels (Marissa) to be taped inside crate lid and logged in our returns spreadsheet. Return pickup window May 19, 0900–1200.
- If any unit fails in-staging, keep a ‘hot laptop’ console to demo via remote tether; Marissa to confirm remote test credentials.
- For insurance claims: take 6 images (crate exterior, crate interior, serial plate, packing list, shipping label, receipt of delivery).

Vendor details I need you to confirm with FedEx Freight (Alan): account number, estimated BOL, liftgate fee, insurance surcharge. Marissa — please confirm carrier appointment and share tracking numbers as soon as available. Grace — confirm the print run for the one-pagers in Drive and upload final PDF to the folder below.

Thanks — Diego

Attachment: return-labels-template.pdf
